sex.evidence: Ten male Long-Evans rats were housed in pairs in enriched plastic cages

dosing.evidence: Psilocin (0.3 mg/kg) or saline was subcutaneously injected in a 2 mL/kg volume 30 minutes before testing... freshly prepared in 0.9% NaCl with glacial acetic acid

group_housing.evidence: Ten male Long-Evans rats were housed in pairs

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained at 22 °C, 40% humidity, under a 12hour light/dark cycle (direction not stated)

enrichment_housing.evidence: housed in pairs in enriched plastic cages with chew toys and polyvinyl chloride (PVC) tubes

assays.assay_name: 2-Choice Visual Discrimination Task (Y-shaped maze; luminance-based and motion-based)
assays.assay_description: PVC maze with 62-cm entrance corridor and sliding door leading to 2 arms (50 cm, 120° angle) with screens at the ends. Food-restricted rats chose between screens: luminance-based task (black vs white) and motion-based task (static vs dynamically distorted gratings). 3-day testing (baseline, saline, psilocin 0.3 mg/kg s.c. 30 min pre-test; 24 test trials, all responses rewarded), posttreatment session next day, retest after 1-week washout. Measures: correct ratio (discrimination impairment) and decision time (EthoVision).

application_type.evidence: Psilocin (0.3 mg/kg) or saline was subcutaneously injected in a 2 mL/kg volume 30 minutes before testing.

setup_habituation.evidence: No explicit apparatus habituation without data collection described; rats were extensively trained in the maze (20 trials per session, 5 sessions a week) and training data are reported.

setup_restrain.evidence: Each trial began when the maze door opened, which allowed the rat to enter and choose between 2 screens.

food_restriction.evidence: Food restriction ensured motivation for reward-based learning, with weights maintained above 90% of baseline.

water_restriction.evidence: Water was available ad libitum (home cage); no water source described in the maze during testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: On the third day, psilocin (0.3 mg/kg) was administered, and testing occurred 30 minutes postinjection

sample_size.evidence: Six rats were tested in both tasks. (Ten male Long-Evans rats housed; within-subject design)

outcomes.summary: Psilocin (0.3 mg/kg s.c.) reduced the correct ratio relative to saline (93.3% vs 72.7%), with impairment significantly greater in the motion-based than the luminance-based task, where performance remained intact. Decision time was inversely correlated with correct ratio (faster decisions associated with greater impairment).
outcomes.statistics: Correct ratio saline vs psilocin: dependent t test, t11 = 4.693, p < .001; decision time vs correct ratio: Pearson r = -0.440, p < .050; motion vs luminance impairment: t5 = 4.067, p < .001
outcomes.evidence: The correct ratio was significantly lower in psilocin trials than in saline trials (dependent Student's t test, t11 = 4.693, p < .001)... Discrimination impairment varied by task complexity, being significantly greater in the motion-based task than the luminance-based task (dependent Student's t test, t5 = 4.067, p < .001)

B1_num_measures.evidence: the correct ratio was calculated as the proportion of correctly solved trials per session... decision time - the time spent in a predefined decision area per trial

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Correct ratio calculated per session; no within-session time-course analysis reported.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Measures are choice accuracy and decision time in a maze; no natural-repertoire behaviours scored.

B5_social.evidence: Visual discrimination task with individual rats; no social construct.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Rats were trained 20 trials per session, 5 sessions a week, until they achieved an 85% accuracy threshold over 3 consecutive sessions.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: decision time... was extracted from above-view video recordings using EthoVision Pro v.3.1.1

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only univariate t tests and a Pearson correlation reported.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Rats were trained in a 2-choice visual discrimination task using a PVC-manufactured maze

E6_spatial.evidence: The maze consists of a 62-cm entrance corridor with a sliding door leading to 2 arms positioned at a 120° angle.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each trial began when the maze door opened, which allowed the rat to enter and choose between 2 screens.

E8_food_water.evidence: A correct response triggered a cornball reward... Rewards were delivered via aluminum tubes ending 1 cm above the floor.

D1_continuity.evidence: The 3-day testing phase... On the first day (baseline)... On the second day, rats received saline... On the third day, psilocin (0.3 mg/kg) was administered

D2_session_duration.evidence: not reported (session length given only in trials: 20 training trials followed by 24 testing trials)

D3_recording_days.evidence: 3-day testing phase plus a posttreatment training session the following day (and retest after 1-week washout)

D4_baseline.evidence: On the first day (baseline) (Figure 2A), rats completed 20 training trials followed by 24 testing trials

D5_followup.evidence: A posttreatment training session was conducted the following day to verify that psilocin exposure did not impair task retention.

D6_circadian.evidence: Short trial-based sessions; no session ≥6 h.

judge_notes: Merged deepseek4's separate 'Motion-based' and 'Luminance-based' visual discrimination assays into one assay: same maze, same choice behaviour, same measures (correct ratio, decision time); only stimulus parameters differ, which the rubric defines as one assay.
Human experiment (oral psilocybin in volunteers) excluded as non-rodent.
B1 set to 1 ('2-3'): gemma4's score of 2 was inconsistent with its own '2-3' category.
E8 scored 1 following the modal candidate (cornball food rewards delivered in-apparatus).
water_restriction set to 'during' per rubric C5 (no water in maze during test; ad libitum refers to home cage), overriding modal 'no'.
D2 scored 0 with low confidence: session duration is not stated in minutes, only trial counts.
n_total set to 6 (rats tested in both tasks; t11 reflects 6 rats x 2 tasks); 10 rats were housed overall.
